desc: Reduce the problem to maximizing internal alkane vertices: they form a connected subtree of vertices with original degree at least 4 and selected internal degree at most 4; an optimum with \(I\) internal vertices has exactly \(3I+2\) total vertices.
Derive and validate the internal-skeleton directed-edge rerooting DP.
Design an iterative \(O(N)\) implementation of the directed-message rerooting DP, including top-four exclusion handling per vertex.
Verify edge cases and provide the final stdin/stdout Python solution.
